fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Reduced forward visibility from combined curve-and-vegetation at a slip-road approach is a genuine collision-risk mechanism affecting both drivers and verge pedestrians, squarely within GG 119 Stage 1 scope.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is directly anchored to the verbatim EV-UK-025 decision-log transcription ('Curve of road and vegetation reduces forward visibility... clear passage by pedestrians... Vegetation clearance will be extended'), exceeding registry-citation-only; EV-UK-002 is merely contextual.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety_concern rather than a compliance matter, with the accepted remediation action restated as a closure condition without conflating design-compliance questions into the safety issue.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific, measurable and viable: deliver and evidence extended clearance across both logged locations, verify post-clearance driver sight lines and unobstructed pedestrian passage before handover — actionable and tied to an already-agreed duty.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are named road users, the scenario explicitly serves them via the clear-passage requirement, and the recommendation verifies unobstructed pedestrian passage alongside driver visibility — VRUs are fully integrated.

justifications.substance: Obscured sight lines to a trunk-road off-slip terminus undermining driver awareness of the need to slow is a substantive safety issue squarely relevant to the signage scheme's purpose at Stage 1.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claim is supported by the verbatim quoted decision-log text in EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), exceeding the registry-id-only cap.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly raised as a safety_concern with no compliance claim; the acceptance-criterion framing stays anchored to driver-awareness risk reduction consistent with GG 119 audit semantics.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Recommendation is specific (drive-through check at design speed after clearance), actionable, and viable with recording in the handover file alongside the agreed RSA action; not null.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are plausibly absent from the slip carriageway context and the finding explicitly acknowledges their non-exposure while scoping to vehicle occupants.
